DISCLOSUREOFMATERIALINFORMATION
Dear Sir(s):
In accordancewithSection15DoftheSecurities and ExchangeOrdinance,1969,PSX
Rule No.5.6.1.of PakistanStockExchange Limited,we convey thefollowinginformation:
Itistoinform that anExtraordinaryGeneral MeetingofSuiNorthernGasPipelines
Limited was adjourned on June 23,2020 at 11:00 a.m.at Gas House,21-Kashmir Road,Lahore
due tostayorder of Hon'bleLahore High Court,Lahore dated June 22,2020restraining the
Company to carry onwith itselectionprocesswithin the stipulated timein accordancewithlaw.
Now,theHon'ble LahoreHigh Court,Lahorein its judgment datedJuly,03,2020has
vacated thestay order datedJune 22,2020 and allowed theCompany toconductElection of
Directors.In the light of the aforesaid judgment of theHon'ble Lahore High Court,Lahore,an
emergent meeting of the Board of Directors was called today i.e. July 03,2020 at 03:30 p.m.,
whereintheBoardofDirectorshaveaccordedapprovalforreconveningofadjourned
Extraordinary General meeting on July 06,2020 at 09:00 a.m.at Company's Head Office,
21-KashmirRoad,Lahore to conduct Election of Directors of the Company.
Copyof DetailedJudgmentoftheHon'ble LahoreHigh Court,Lahore andNoticefor
reconvening of adjourned Extraordinary General Meeting on July 06,2020 at 09:00a.m.is
attachedherewithforinformationofall concerned.
Weencloseherewithdisclosureforminterms of section15Dof theSecurities and
Exchange Ordinance,1969.
Thanks and regards.
Yours sincerely,
SUINORTHERNGASPIPELINESLIMITED
